items.condition: Authenticated owner, primary document, !embedded, relativePath available, state present, mode=source. Distinguish clean, valid dirty, invalid draft and recovery.
items.fields: state.markdown entire document, fixed showLineNumbers=true, default wrap=true, readOnly=!editable; editable=resource.capabilities.canEdit && !recovered; body inert on recovery. update:modelValue -> markdownEdit -> editMarkdown preserves input; valid same type updates title and inline source for non-excalidraw. <=720 editor uses mobile padding/font; vertical scrolling, natural wrapping. No separate source protocol form.
actionsAndGuards: History disabled loading||saving||recovered; share disabled loading||shareBusy; both only !embedded. Save disabled loading||saving||!editable, no dirty requirement for button; status loading > saving > error > dirty > saved. More opens download complete (disabled loading||saving), Markdown, source (disabled loading||!canDownloadSource). Shared badge only if shared&&!embedded.

Design tab disabled !editable; source/read/PNG disabled loading||!state. Dirty handoff must save; block if still dirty/error. HTML/print disabled loading||saving||readingExportBusy; PNG disabled exporting||!editable. Phone mode tabs precede tool strip.

Persist draft, validate diagram declaration/type/excalidraw path, render PNG, POST /api/diagram-documents/prepare, apply prepared binding to complete Markdown and persist pending evidence before POST /api/diagram-documents/commit. Reuse pending evidence on retry, verify document/source hashes and refresh current note/resource. Dirty autosave subject to pause/error/loading/saving/recovery. Bad declaration retains text, shows 图形 Markdown 不完整，请在源码中修复; retry/reload disabled while saving, download draft available. No ordinary-note PUT or prepare/commit buttons.

items.dataAndGuards: Saved: revisions.length, selected, mode=compare, patch!==undefined, loaded module, parsed DiffDocument.status=ready. GET revisions (+cursor), POST revision read; compare fully read historic text against current saved content only, guard stale/missing/large baseline. 1 MiB per side, 256 KiB max patch, bounded edit count/time. Dirty draft excluded. Source switch, selection, closing and restore guarded by busy||git.busy||savePending||git.pendingRestore. Restore starts second confirmation; pending save supplies check-result branch. Compare computes locally.
items.loadedActions: Saved passes diff=patch, fileLabel=title, toolbarTarget=diffToolbarHost. Layout buttons teleported to .note-history-layout-outlet beside compare/source tabs. 逐行 default vs 左右对照; narrow if innerWidth<640 OR positive renderer width<600, forces unified and disables side-by-side; preferred layout resumes when widened. <=360 compact tab/tool padding. Generic narrow hint exists in DOM but both native history branches hide it in .note-history-detail CSS. No retry when ready. Parsed file heading/count, hunk, 旧行/新行/内容 vs 旧行/旧内容/新行/新内容, +/- and line numbers, 原始差异 initially collapsed, user can expand. Empty/loading no layout switch; parser unavailable retry differs from importing component failed; truncated Git notice only. Binary/metadata-only messages conditional.

minimumSpec.scope: One local saved-compare control-row and body board; 2 independent panels, same valid one-file patch/label/count, no repeated full modal.

minimumSpec.mobile: 320 (<=360 padding); active 差异对比, 逐行 selected and 左右对照 disabled, three columns with change rows and matching count, same collapsed raw disclosure. No visible 窗口较窄… hint, no loading/unavailable/retry. 390 has same branch.
